description: Log money the user tells you about in their Bluu books; Bluu never moves money or pays anyone. Something they spent, money they received, a move between their own accounts or spaces, a fix to the last thing logged here, or taking it back; or fix or delete an entry this chat added earlier, by its `ref`. Fill in exactly ONE. Every detail must come from the user, or from a statement, receipt or screenshot they shared with you here — ask for anything missing, the category above all; never guess. Check a file's rows with `statements` (`rows`) first: it lists the user's categories to propose from and the rows Bluu already has. Record a file's rows with `rows`, up to 40 on one card, and confirm each batch only on the user's yes to it. You can change or delete ONLY what was added from this chat: anything else is changed in Bluu, and Bluu answers with the link to it. An expense for everyone on a trip ("para todos", "for all of us") is not an expense here: use `split` with a `bill` in the trip's space. Nothing is saved until they approve it with `confirm`. Never approve on their behalf.
